notes.title: Welcome! Welcome to Ticket to Paradise!
notes.content:
[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/1.png[/img]

[h1]Thank You![/h1]
Thank you for your reservation! You are about embark on a vacation for a life time!

Somewhere Land Resort only cares about YOUR satisfaction! Please, before your trip, read about our wonderful attractions and amenities below.



[h1]Spectacular Shopping for your Armanent Needs[/h1]
Dyson City Armanents provides the best firearms and weapons Somewhere Land has to offer!

After a relaxing day on the beach, perhaps you would like to shop for your new favorite weapon for self defense against those pesky locals!

10 of our newest weapons are available to ALL of our guests! Here is a taste...

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/2.png[/img]

The long rifle is a burst fire rifle, capable of taking out enemies from a far with a rapid fire capability!

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/3.png[/img]

The boomerang is an exotic oddity of a weapon, and always returns to its user when thrown!
However if you don't catch it when it returns.. well, lets just say resort staff are not resonsible for ANY casualities that happen from self-boomerang accidents.



[h1]Chances to win Golden Tickets[/h1]
If you ever thought your favorite weapon ever needed a little pizzaz, enter our sweepstakes to win golden tickets!

What are golden tickets you ask?

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/4.png[/img]

If you thought the old, obsolete system of a random golden weapon was frustrating, then fear not, our new revamped system will let you, our precious guest, choose what golden weapon you unlock!

Golden tickets can be won with a 14% chance after leveling up! So if you win one, your weapon of choice will be quite a rarity...
Guests who are visiting our resort for free will be able to earn these tickets as much as the premium members!

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/5.png[/img]

When you posess one or more golden tickets, head over to your weapons unlock screen to make your choice.

Weapon unlock of current guest censored. We care about guest privacy at Somewhereland Resorts!



[h1]New, exciting locale![/h1]
Get a tour to our newest location, The Man's Throne Room!

The Man is our peoples' largest threat to existence, but that won't stop us from profiting off of his place of residence!

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/6.png[/img]

Explore the evil magician's home, with disturbing torture chambers and large statues dedicated to his evil presence!



[h1]Fun and games![/h1]
Take part of the new and improved Survival mode! Feel like the heroes of USC by battling against the forces of evil!

Survive wave after wave of The Man's minions, based from past experiences of USC fabled hero, Boring Man! The further you get, the enemies get tougher...

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/7.png[/img]

Find treasure to boost your abilities! Sometimes they even carry our valuable golden tickets.... but only if you're an experienced, regular guest and have a level over 80!

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/8.png[/img]

Alcohol and smokes can make your character do more damage, run faster, and have wacky abilities! You can check what items you have any time you want...

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/9.png[/img]

Collecting multiple of the same item can stack! So having 2 bottles of Ale can increase your damage by 4.

On occasion, stronger staff members will jump into your match and try to put you under control if you're too good and need to be stopped!



[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/10.png[/img]

[h1]An Important Apology from resort CEO, Spasman[/h1]
Guests,
I regret to inform ALL of our guests the following information. Here at resort Le Somewhereland, we keep our inner workings transparent and keep you, the valued guest informed!

All future guests that attend our resort will need to have their progress reset.
Yes, your save file will be wiped, but it will happen to everyone! So think of it as a fresh start instead of starting over.

Experienced guests have nothing to learn from bots, zombie AI and survival enemies. When you reach level 80, you will no longer gain XP from our staff members! You will only be able to get XP from, ahem, "interacting" with the other guests!
So get out there and socialize!

For those certain guests out and about looking to do some, uhm, "business" with me, you can now encounter me in Survival mode! It's totally me, I swear. Not a robot.

Lastly, resort maintenence is still going on, but you can expect to see our new faculties to open up before August!

Thank you to all guests, current and shopping! What you have just read is merely a taste.. remember to check the change log when its released! Please consider coming to our resort, or coming back on your next planned holiday.

- Spasman, CEO

notes.title: Boring Man v1.1.7.1 is now available
notes.content:
I actually really sat down and played my own game last night and all evening today, and realized I've been neglecting a weapons house cleaning quite a bit. I've been so caught up with work and fixing the netcode I forgot to fix the weapons themselves.

So a bit of weapon rebalancing was in order. If a weapon got a nerf, it was because I felt like using it was a mindless activity you could farm a lot of kills with or hurt the game balance in its own special way.

Any buffs I gave to a weapon I felt like I was struggling far too much to keep a decent kdr with (compared to the regular or OP weapons)

Changelog:

Fixed/Changed

- Pingable servers are now sorted to the top (correctly..)

Weapons

- Increased fire rate of the assault rifle
- Increased fire rate of the power rifle
- Slightly increased chain gun damage
- Decreased damage on the acid gun
- Increased damage on the machine gun
- Decreased push back on the light rockets
- Increased accuracy of the musket
- Acid gun now has damage fall off
- Increased damage on the plinger
- Increased damage on the pump shotgun
- Increased damage on the double barrel
- Increased dual pistol damage and fire rate
- Increased bolt action’s reload speed

notes.title: Pings removed from server list (v1.1.5.1)
notes.content:
I have removed pings from the server list in v1.1.5.1 as it was confusing the netcode and making players unable to connect to most servers.

This isn't a guarantee all you can join most servers now (port forwards are still required), but it should have improved it. The server would get confused with pings from the server list as real players, so when the player would try to join after receiving a ping, the server would think two players joined and then think they're bugged clones and kick them out.

Server list pings were actually a fairly new feature for the Steam version, for a long time B-Man didn't have pings on the server list.. so I guess we're going back to that.

Due to the game's small population, I don't think this will be too missed. However if you are a server owner, I strongly recommend putting your region somewhere in your server name so close-ish people can find you.

I have also manually subtracted ~27ms from ping times, because extensive testing on my part has revealed it takes this much time to receive a ping logically, not through the internet. The netcode performance won't have a increase, its just showing a better ball park average of what your ping is on the server.

Anyways I apologize for the shoddy workmanship on this game. It's my first online game. and I apologize for adding a nice feature and then removing it. If I find an alternative method to server list pinging, then I will defnitely use it, but that feature will be gone for now as it was affecting the game too much. Yes it will be slightly more difficult to weed through the not-portforwarded garbage but it's the best I can do for now.

ONE MORE TIME, this won't solve *all* TCP Error problems, you will still get them, but I think it will improve a little.

- Spasman

notes.title: Boring Man Beta Branch
notes.content:
I've created a new B-Man branch that let you download an early version of the game's next update.

I will use this branch to experiment fixes and test features and possibly find more bugs. It's entirely optional and available to everyone.

Some pros and cons about playing in beta mode:

Pros:
[list]
[*] See bug fixes and new content early

[*] Smaller population so maybe more likely to get into a server

[*] Support Spasman in his time of need and become a hardcore B-Man fan.

[*] I will also be paying attention to my one server that will be up quite a bit, so it's a good chance to get the achievement for killing me.
[/list]
Cons:
[list]
[*] Unstable

[*] Some maps are modified but not whitelisted yet, so you may not get XP. The game will warn you if this is happening.
[/list]
The game will also state the version you have is "outdated" but in fact will display a later number then the current version. This is natural.

Anyways, if you'd like to help test the new version, this is how you do it:

1. Open your steam library, right click B-Man

2. Select "Properties"

3. Select the Betas tab

4. Click the drop down and select "beta", close the window

Steam should automatically reinstall the game, but if it doesn't you should either reinstall it yourself or restart Steam.

If you wish to go back to the stable version (I use that term lightly), simply follow the instructions above again but choose "NONE" instead of "beta".

I will be running 1 test server in beta mode, but you're welcome to run a server yourself as well. The server list doesn't show servers that match your game version, so it will appear more empty then usual.

My server will be ran from the game's dev build, and I will also be shutting it down a lot to make tweaks to the code.

Thank you for helping me test, I can do most game developer stuff by myself but it's difficult to test without a dedicated Q/A team.
